record.what_it_does: Salesforce is a cloud CRM platform for managing sales, service, and marketing data, accessible programmatically via REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and Bulk APIs.
record.auth_notes: Access is via External Client Apps or Connected Apps using OAuth 2.0 authorization flows (including JWT bearer and username-password variants, which are OAuth 2.0 grant types, not separate credential systems). As of Spring '26, Salesforce restricts creation of new Connected Apps in favor of External Client Apps, though existing Connected Apps keep working.
record.access_notes: Salesforce offers a free, non-time-limited Developer Edition org (with API access) obtained via self-serve signup, no payment required.
record.main_blocker: Each customer needs their own Salesforce org plus an admin-configured External Client App/Connected App with OAuth; new Connected App creation is now restricted (Spring '26+), pushing setup toward External Client Apps.

evidence.quote: it must be integrated with your org's REST API using the OAuth 2.0 protocol
